questionDetail.sql:
select sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue
  from v_orders o
 where o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '12 months'
   and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'

select coalesce(sum(o.total_price), 0) as total_revenue
  from v_orders o
 where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', to_timestamp('2025-12-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) 
   and o.created_at_platform < date_trunc('month', to_timestamp('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
   and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'

with monthly_sales as (
  select date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform) as month,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 year'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform)
)
select gs.month, coalesce(ms.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue
  from generate_series(date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 year', date_trunc('month', now()), interval '1 month') as gs(month)
  left join monthly_sales ms on ms.month = gs.month
 order by gs.month

select count(o.order_number) as total_orders
  from v_orders o
 where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month'
   and o.created_at_platform < date_trunc('month', now())
   and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'

with sold as (
  select oi.product_ref, oi.title, sum(oi.quantity) as units_sold
    from v_order_items oi
   where oi.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and oi.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by oi.product_ref, oi.title
)
select s.title, s.units_sold
  from sold s
 order by s.units_sold desc
 limit 10

with revenue as (
  select oi.product_ref, oi.title, sum(oi.line_total) as total_revenue
    from v_order_items oi
   where oi.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and oi.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by oi.product_ref, oi.title
)
select r.title, r.total_revenue
  from revenue r
 order by r.total_revenue desc
 limit 5

with sales as (
  select oi.product_ref, oi.title, sum(oi.quantity) as units_sold
    from v_order_items oi
    join v_orders o on o.order_number = oi.order_number
   where oi.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('year', now())
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by oi.product_ref, oi.title
)
select title, units_sold
  from sales
 order by units_sold asc
 limit 1

with revenue_by_category as (
  select p.product_type,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue
    from v_orders o
    join v_order_items oi on oi.order_number = o.order_number
    join v_products p on p.product_ref = oi.product_ref
   where o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by p.product_type
)
select product_type, coalesce(total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue
  from revenue_by_category
 order by total_revenue desc

with current_quarter as (
  select date_trunc('quarter', o.created_at_platform) as quarter,
         sum(o.total_price) as revenue
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '3 months'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by date_trunc('quarter', o.created_at_platform)
), previous_quarter as (
  select date_trunc('quarter', o.created_at_platform) as quarter,
         sum(o.total_price) as revenue
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform < date_trunc('quarter', now()) 
     and o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '6 months'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by date_trunc('quarter', o.created_at_platform)
)
select coalesce(cq.quarter, pq.quarter) as quarter,
       coalesce(cq.revenue, 0) as current_quarter_revenue,
       coalesce(pq.revenue, 0) as previous_quarter_revenue
  from current_quarter cq
  full outer join previous_quarter pq on cq.quarter = pq.quarter
 order by quarter desc

with sales_q4_2025 as (
  select sum(o.total_price) as total_sales
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', to_timestamp('2025-10-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) 
     and o.created_at_platform < date_trunc('quarter', to_timestamp('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
), sales_q1_2026 as (
  select sum(o.total_price) as total_sales
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', to_timestamp('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) 
     and o.created_at_platform < date_trunc('quarter', to_timestamp('2026-04-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
)
select coalesce(q4.total_sales, 0) as q4_2025_sales, coalesce(q1.total_sales, 0) as q1_2026_sales
  from sales_q4_2025 q4, sales_q1_2026 q1

with sales_per_month as (
  select oi.product_ref,
         date_trunc('month', oi.created_at_platform) as month,
         sum(oi.quantity) as units_sold
    from v_order_items oi
   where oi.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '4 months'
     and oi.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by oi.product_ref, date_trunc('month', oi.created_at_platform)
)
select sp.product_ref,
       coalesce(sum(units_sold) filter (where month = date_trunc('month', now() - interval '2 months')), 0) as previous_sales,
       coalesce(sum(units_sold) filter (where month = date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month')), 0) as current_sales
  from sales_per_month sp
 group by sp.product_ref
 order by coalesce(sum(units_sold) filter (where month = date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month')), 0) - 
          coalesce(sum(units_sold) filter (where month = date_trunc('month', now() - interval '2 months')), 0) asc
 limit 20

with revenue_per_month as (
  select date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform) as month,
         sum(o.total_price) as revenue
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('year', now()) - interval '1 year'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform)
)
select to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
       coalesce(sum(revenue) filter (where month >= date_trunc('year', now())), 0) as current_year_revenue,
       coalesce(sum(revenue) filter (where month < date_trunc('year', now())), 0) as last_year_revenue
  from revenue_per_month
 group by month
 order by month

select count(*) as recurrent_customers
  from v_customers
 where orders_count >= 2

select customer_ref, total_spent
  from v_customers
 order by total_spent desc
 limit 10

select count(*) * 100.0 / (select count(*) from v_customers) as percentage_repeat_customers
  from v_customers
 where orders_count > 1

select count(*) as new_customers_count
  from v_customers
 where first_order_at >= now() - interval '3 months'

select customer_ref, city, province, country, last_order_at
  from v_customers
 where last_order_at < now() - interval '6 months'

select avg(total_price) as average_order_value
  from v_orders
 where created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
   and financial_status <> 'refunded'

with monthly_revenue as (
  select date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform) as month,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue,
         count(o.order_number) as order_count
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '12 months'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform)
)
select month,
       total_revenue,
       order_count,
       case when order_count > 0 then total_revenue / order_count else 0 end as average_ticket
  from monthly_revenue
 order by month desc
 limit 12

with repeat_customers as (
  select o.customer_ref,
         avg(o.total_price) as avg_order_value
    from v_orders o
   where o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
     and o.customer_ref is not null
     and o.customer_ref in (select customer_ref from v_customers where orders_count >= 2)
   group by o.customer_ref
), first_time_buyers as (
  select o.customer_ref,
         avg(o.total_price) as avg_order_value
    from v_orders o
   where o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
     and o.customer_ref is not null
     and o.customer_ref in (select customer_ref from v_customers where orders_count = 1)
   group by o.customer_ref
)
select 'Repeat Customers' as customer_type, avg(avg_order_value) as avg_order_value
  from repeat_customers
union all
select 'First-Time Buyers' as customer_type, avg(avg_order_value) as avg_order_value
  from first_time_buyers

select product_ref, product_title, sku, quantity, location
  from v_inventory
 where quantity = 0
 limit 1000

select product_ref, product_title, quantity, location
  from v_inventory
 where quantity < 20
 limit 1000

select i.location, sum(i.quantity) as total_units_in_stock
  from v_inventory i
 group by i.location
 order by i.location

with sold as (
  select oi.product_ref, oi.title, sum(oi.quantity) as units_sold
    from v_order_items oi
   where oi.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and oi.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by oi.product_ref, oi.title
), stock as (
  select i.product_ref, sum(i.quantity) as units_in_stock
    from v_inventory i
   group by i.product_ref
)
select s.title, s.units_sold, coalesce(k.units_in_stock, 0) as units_in_stock
  from sold s
  join stock k on k.product_ref = s.product_ref
 where k.units_in_stock < 50
 order by s.units_sold desc
 limit 20

with sales_per_country as (
  select c.country,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue
    from v_orders o
    join v_customers c on c.customer_ref = o.customer_ref
   where o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by c.country
)
select country, total_revenue
  from sales_per_country
 order by total_revenue desc
 limit 20

with revenue_by_province as (
  select c.province,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue
    from v_orders o
    join v_customers c on c.customer_ref = o.customer_ref
   where c.country = 'Spain'
     and o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by c.province
)
select province, coalesce(total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue
  from revenue_by_province
 order by total_revenue desc
 limit 1000

questionDetail.detail: No hay datos sobre regiones o crecimiento en el esquema.

questionDetail.sql:
with city_orders as (
  select c.city, count(o.order_number) as orders_count
    from v_orders o
    join v_customers c on c.customer_ref = o.customer_ref
   where o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by c.city
)
select city, orders_count
  from city_orders
 order by orders_count desc
 limit 5

select count(o.order_number) as returned_orders_count
  from v_orders o
 where o.financial_status = 'refunded'
   and o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('year', now())

with total_orders as (
  select count(*) as order_count
    from v_orders
   where created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
), refunded_orders as (
  select count(*) as refunded_count
    from v_orders
   where created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and financial_status = 'refunded'
)
select coalesce((refunded_count::decimal / order_count) * 100, 0) as refund_percentage
  from total_orders, refunded_orders

with returned as (
  select oi.product_ref, oi.title, sum(oi.quantity) as total_returned
    from v_order_items oi
    join v_orders o on o.order_number = oi.order_number
   where o.financial_status = 'refunded'
   group by oi.product_ref, oi.title
)
select r.title, r.total_returned
  from returned r
 order by r.total_returned desc
 limit 20

select coalesce(sum(o.total_discounts), 0) as total_discounts
  from v_orders o
 where o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '3 months'
   and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'

with discounted_orders as (
  select o.order_number, o.total_price
    from v_orders o
   where o.total_discounts > 0
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
), non_discounted_orders as (
  select o.order_number, o.total_price
    from v_orders o
   where o.total_discounts = 0
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
)
select 'Discounted' as order_type, avg(total_price) as average_ticket
  from discounted_orders
union all
select 'Non-Discounted' as order_type, avg(total_price) as average_ticket
  from non_discounted_orders

with sales as (
  select o.source_name,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_sales
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by o.source_name
)
select source_name, coalesce(total_sales, 0) as total_sales
  from sales
 order by total_sales desc

with sales_per_day as (
  select date_part('dow', o.created_at_platform) as day_of_week,
         sum(o.total_price) as total_revenue
    from v_orders o
   where o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
     and o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
   group by date_part('dow', o.created_at_platform)
)
select day_of_week, total_revenue
  from sales_per_day
 order by total_revenue desc
 limit 1

select count(o.order_number) as unfulfilled_orders
  from v_orders o
 where o.fulfillment_status <> 'fulfilled'
